context: Governing Law: This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida, without regard to its conflict-of-laws or choice-of law principles
In case of a dispute, the parties agree to pursue Arbitration as the preferred method to seek a remedy and the parties waive the right to a jury trial
Assignment: This Agreement, or the rights granted under it, may not be assigned transferred or sublicense by either party without the express prior written consent of the other party
Entire Agreement: This Agreement and its attachments constitute the entire agreement between the parties and supersede all prior agreements, oral or written, relating to the Sponsorship
This Agreement may only be admitted in a writing signed by both parties
The agreement is confidential, and the parties agree not to file or record in public records

contract_agreement_summary: Agreement between Fruit of Life Productions LLC (Promoter) and Eco Science Solutions, Inc. (Sponsor) for sponsorship of Kaya Fest.
Sponsor agrees to pay $250000.00 in full upon signing the agreement for the right to sponsor the event and be acknowledged as a promoter.

Sponsorship benefits include main stage naming rights, vendor booths, VIP passes, parking passes, participation in after-party, banner placements, logo placement on various media, and social media mentions.
The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Florida, with arbitration as the preferred method for dispute resolution.
The agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the parties and supersedes all prior agreements.
compliance_and_expectations_summary: Sponsor agrees to abide by the terms set forth in the Terms and Conditions of Sponsorship agreement.
Each party warrants compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
Sponsors are responsible for creating, hanging, and removing their own banners, ensuring they are securely placed and safe.
Sponsors must have their own liability insurance with limits of one million dollars if exhibiting.
Each party shall use the other party's Confidential Information only for purposes of this Agreement with written authorization.
Each party shall restrict disclosure of the other party's Confidential Information to its employees and agents with a reasonable need to know such Confidential Information.
Parties shall exercise due care and act in good faith at all times in the performance of obligations.
termination_and_expiry_summary: The term of the agreement begins on April 1, 2018, and continues until April 30, 2018, at 11:59 pm.

Kaya Fest shall not be liable to any Sponsor for losses arising out of the inability to perform its obligations under the terms of this sponsorship proposal due to acts of God, which include, but are not limited to, fire, flood, tornados, hurricanes, severe increments weather, strikes, medical failure, or any other acts beyond the control of Kaya Fest.
